out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): 1) half and half
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC AND STAFF TO LABEL THE HALF AND HALF FOR EVERY 4 HOURS. STAFF STARTED A TIMER FOR THE HALF AND HALF. PIC STATES HE WILL START LABELING TPHC FOODS.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloth under the espresso machine was observed being stored in water
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO USE THE QUATERNARY AMMONIA DISPENSER AT THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK. WHEN TESTED, SANITIZER SOLUTION WAS OBSERVED IN THE APPROPRIATE RANGE.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed an unapproved Y splitter attached to the mop sink
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS PROVIDE PIC WITH INFORMATION ABOUT AN APPROVED BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE. PLEASE ORDER AND INSTALL.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used to clean espresso steamer wands were observed sitting on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. PIC PUT WIPING CLOTHS IN A BUCKET OF SANITIZER.
